description:
The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} serves mocked usage and pricing. To "open the spend popup": navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, then click the VISIBLE ".context-usage-label" element (a hidden one may exist too; pick the visible one). "The popup" is the ".chat-context-popup" element; "the table" is the element inside the popup with role "table" and accessible name "Spend by model". When a step says an element's text "matches" a regular expression, test the regular expression against the element's raw textContent in an eval that has "expect". Perform the steps in order. The spend popup shows per-model main and sub-agent spend with subtotals at a 768px-wide window.
1. Open the spend popup. The table is visible.
2. The table's column headers (role "columnheader" inside the table) have exactly these texts, in order: "Model / tokens", "Main conversation", "Sub-agents".
3. The table's [data-testid="conversation-cost-subtotal"] text contains "$3.73"; its [data-testid="subagent-cost-row"] text contains "$8.25"; its [data-testid="token-cost-total"] text contains "≈$11.98".
4. "The breakdowns" are the table's ".token-cost-model-breakdown" elements: there are exactly 3.
5. The first breakdown's ".token-cost-model-row" text matches /main-model.*\$3.45.*—/, and the second breakdown's ".token-cost-model-row" text matches /review-model.*—.*\$7.50/.
6. The second breakdown's '.token-cost-legend-row [data-scope="subagents"]' elements are exactly 4, and their texts match, in order: /250k\s*@ \$8\/M\s*\$2.00/, /2.0M\s*@ \$2\/M\s*\$4.00/, /200k\s*@ \$2.50\/M\s*\$0.500/ and /5.0M\s*@ \$0.20\/M\s*\$1.00/.
7. The third breakdown's text contains "unpriced-model" and contains "$0.750 reported"; it has no ".token-cost-legend-row .token-cost-legend-unit" element (count 0).
8. The popup's text contains "1 call has no model pricing" and contains "Sub-agent model totals include nested sub-agents and indirect usage.".
9. The table's text contains "Other (indirect)" and contains "in model totals".
10. In one eval with expect "true", using getBoundingClientRect(): the table's second column header ("Main conversation") and third column header ("Sub-agents") have exactly the same y; the third's x is >= the second's x + width; the popup's x is >= 0 and its x + width is <= 768; and the popup's scrollWidth <= its clientWidth.

steps.text: Sub-agent model totals include nested sub-agents and indirect usage.

steps.expression: (function() { const table = document.querySelector('table[aria-label="Spend by model"]'); const headers = table.querySelectorAll('th[scope="col"]'); const h2 = headers[1].getBoundingClientRect(); const h3 = headers[2].getBoundingClientRect(); const popup = document.querySelector('.chat-context-popup'); const popupRect = popup.getBoundingClientRect(); return ( h2.y === h3.y && h3.x >= h2.x + h2.width && popupRect.x >= 0 && popupRect.x + popupRect.width <= 768 && popup.scrollWidth <= popup.clientWidth ); })()
